simple.meaning: מַכְאֹב (makʼôb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “anguish or (figuratively) affliction.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 16 times across Exodus, 2 Chronicles, Job, Psalms, Ecclesiastes, and 3 more, beginning at Exodus 3:7. Its contexts include Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַכְאֹב (H4341).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מַכְאֹב (makʼôb) / H4341 is traced through Exodus 3:7, 2 Chronicles 6:29, Job 33:19, Psalms 32:10 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.
whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who will each know his own plague and his own sorrow, and shall spread out his hands toward this house;
He is chastened also with pain on his bed,
Many sorrows come to the wicked,
For I will declare my iniquity.
Charge them with crime upon crime.
For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.
For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.
Surely he has borne our sickness
Why do you cry over your injury?
‘You said, “Woe is me now! For Yahweh has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.” ’
Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed!
“Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by?

definitions.full: H4341. makob מַכְאוֺב noun masculine Psa 32:10 pain ; — ׳מ absolute Eccl 1:18 2 t.; construct Psa 69:27 ; suffix מַכְאוֺבִי ( מַכְאֹבִי ) 38:18 3 t., etc.; plural מַכְאוֺבִים 32:10 ; Eccl 2:23 ; מַכְאֹבוֺת Isa 53:3 ; suffix מַכְאֹבָיו Exod 3:7 ; מַכְאֹבֵינוּ Isa 53:4 ; — 1 pain , physical, Exod 3:7 (|| עֳנִי ; compare נֹגְשָׂיו מִמְּנֵי in context); 2Chr 6:29 (|| נֶגַע ); Job 33:19 . 2 of mental pain , Psa 32:10 (of troubles of wicked), of Babylon Jer 51:8 ; Psa 38:18 ; 69:27 (as result of sin; of ׳י s servant); in ׳י s word to Baruch Jer 45:3 (|| אֲנָחָה יָגוֺן, ), compare of Israel in distress 30:15 (|| שֵׁבֶר ), of Jerusalem Lam 1:12 (twice in verse); 1:18 , Eccl 1:18 ( מַכ יוֺסִיף דַּעַת ׳יוֺסִיף ); 2:23 (|| עִנְיָנוֺ כַּעַם ); particular of suffering servant of ׳י Isa 53:3-4 , (both || חֳלִי ).
